sn23.3:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Bhavanetti bhavanettīnirodho ti bhante vuccati || katamā nu kho bhante bhavanettī katamo bhavanettīnirodho ti || || Rūpe kho Rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ya upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusāyā || ayaṃ vuccati bhavanettī tesaṃ nirodhā bhavanettīnirodho || || Vedanāya || || Saññāya || || Saṅkhāresu || || Viññāne yo chando || pa || adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā || ayaṃ vuccati bhavanettī tesaṃ nirodhā bhavanettīnirodho ti || ||
